schema.text: If you encounter poor road or path surfaces (potholes, cobblestones, or uneven ground), how does it affect your riding?

options.text: It does not affect my riding at all
I notice it but continue without changing my behaviour
I slow down or adjust my line but stay on the same route
I actively avoid roads with poor surfaces, even if the alternative is longer
Poor surfaces significantly limit where and how often I can ride

en.#If you encounter poor road or path surf: If you encounter poor road or path surfaces (potholes, cobblestones, or uneven ground), how does it affect your riding?
en.#It does not affect my riding at all: It does not affect my riding at all
en.#I notice it but continue without changi: I notice it but continue without changing my behaviour
en.#I slow down or adjust my line but stay: I slow down or adjust my line but stay on the same route
en.#I actively avoid roads with poor surfac: I actively avoid roads with poor surfaces, even if the alternative is longer
en.#Poor surfaces significantly limit where: Poor surfaces significantly limit where and how often I can ride

it.#If you encounter poor road or path surf: Quando incontri strade o percorsi in cattive condizioni, come buche, sampietrini o superfici irregolari, in che modo ciò influisce sui tuoi spostamenti in bici o in monopattino?
it.#It does not affect my riding at all: Non influisce affatto sui miei spostamenti
it.#I notice it but continue without changi: Me ne accorgo, ma continuo senza cambiare comportamento
it.#I slow down or adjust my line but stay: Rallento o modifico la traiettoria, ma rimango sullo stesso percorso
it.#I actively avoid roads with poor surfac: Evito attivamente le strade con superfici in cattive condizioni, anche se il percorso alternativo è più lungo
it.#Poor surfaces significantly limit where: Le superfici in cattive condizioni limitano significativamente dove e quanto spesso posso spostarmi in bici o in monopattino

fr.#If you encounter poor road or path surf: Quand la chaussée ou le chemin est en mauvais état, par exemple avec des nids-de-poule, des pavés ou un sol irrégulier, quel effet cela a-t-il sur vos déplacements à vélo ou en trottinette ?
fr.#It does not affect my riding at all: Cela n’a aucun effet sur mes déplacements
fr.#I notice it but continue without changi: Je le remarque, mais je continue sans changer ma façon de rouler
fr.#I slow down or adjust my line but stay: Je ralentis ou je change légèrement ma trajectoire, mais je reste sur le même itinéraire
fr.#I actively avoid roads with poor surfac: J’évite les routes en mauvais état, même si l’autre itinéraire est plus long
fr.#Poor surfaces significantly limit where: Le mauvais état des surfaces limite fortement les endroits où je peux aller et la fréquence de mes déplacements

de.#If you encounter poor road or path surf: Wenn Straßen oder Wege schlecht sind, zum Beispiel durch Schlaglöcher, Kopfsteinpflaster oder Unebenheiten: Wie wirkt sich das auf Ihre Fahrten mit dem Fahrrad oder E-Scooter aus?
de.#It does not affect my riding at all: Das beeinflusst meine Fahrten gar nicht
de.#I notice it but continue without changi: Ich merke es, fahre aber weiter, ohne mein Verhalten zu ändern
de.#I slow down or adjust my line but stay: Ich fahre langsamer oder ändere meine Linie etwas, bleibe aber auf derselben Strecke
de.#I actively avoid roads with poor surfac: Ich vermeide Straßen mit schlechtem Belag, auch wenn der alternative Weg länger ist
de.#Poor surfaces significantly limit where: Schlechte Oberflächen schränken stark ein, wo und wie oft ich fahren kann

tr.#If you encounter poor road or path surf: Yol veya bisiklet yolu yüzeyi kötü olduğunda, örneğin çukur, taş döşeme veya düzensiz zemin varsa, bu bisiklet veya elektrikli scooter kullanımınızı nasıl etkiler?
tr.#I notice it but continue without changi: Fark ederim ama davranışımı değiştirmeden devam ederim
tr.#I slow down or adjust my line but stay: Yavaşlar veya çizgimi biraz değiştiririm ama aynı güzergâhta kalırım
tr.#I actively avoid roads with poor surfac: Alternatif yol daha uzun olsa bile kötü yüzeyli yolları özellikle kullanmam
tr.#Poor surfaces significantly limit where: Kötü yüzeyler nerede ve ne sıklıkta sürebileceğimi önemli ölçüde sınırlar

fa.#If you encounter poor road or path surf: اگر سطح خیابان یا مسیر بد باشد، مثلاً چاله، سنگفرش یا ناهمواری داشته باشد، چه اثری بر رفت‌وآمد شما با دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی دارد؟
fa.#It does not affect my riding at all: اصلاً بر رفت‌وآمد من اثر ندارد
fa.#I notice it but continue without changi: متوجه می‌شوم، اما بدون تغییر رفتار ادامه می‌دهم
fa.#I slow down or adjust my line but stay: سرعتم را کم می‌کنم یا کمی مسیر حرکت را تغییر می‌دهم، اما در همان مسیر می‌مانم
fa.#I actively avoid roads with poor surfac: حتی اگر مسیر جایگزین طولانی‌تر باشد، از خیابان‌های با سطح نامناسب دوری می‌کنم
fa.#Poor surfaces significantly limit where: سطح نامناسب به‌طور جدی محدود می‌کند کجا و چند وقت یک بار می‌توانم رفت‌وآمد کنم

hu.#If you encounter poor road or path surf: Ha rossz minőségű útfelülettel vagy kerékpárúttal találkozik, például kátyúval, macskakővel vagy egyenetlen talajjal, hogyan befolyásolja ez a kerékpározását vagy rollerezését?
hu.#I notice it but continue without changi: Észreveszem, de a viselkedésem megváltoztatása nélkül továbbhaladok
hu.#I slow down or adjust my line but stay: Lassítok vagy kissé módosítom a nyomvonalamat, de ugyanazon az útvonalon maradok
hu.#I actively avoid roads with poor surfac: Tudatosan kerülöm a rossz burkolatú utakat, még akkor is, ha a másik út hosszabb
hu.#Poor surfaces significantly limit where: A rossz burkolat jelentősen korlátozza, hol és milyen gyakran tudok közlekedni

ar.#If you encounter poor road or path surf: إذا كان سطح الطريق أو المسار سيئًا، مثل وجود حفر أو حجارة رصف أو أرض غير مستوية، كيف يؤثر ذلك في تنقلك بالدراجة أو السكوتر الكهربائي؟
ar.#I notice it but continue without changi: ألاحظه لكنني أواصل من دون تغيير سلوكي
ar.#I slow down or adjust my line but stay: أبطئ أو أغيّر مساري قليلًا لكنني أبقى على الطريق نفسه
ar.#I actively avoid roads with poor surfac: أتجنب الطرق ذات الأسطح السيئة حتى لو كان الطريق البديل أطول
ar.#Poor surfaces significantly limit where: الأسطح السيئة تحد بشكل واضح من الأماكن التي أستطيع التنقل فيها ومن عدد مرات ذلك
